summary: TORM plc filed a 6-K attaching a press release dated October 5, 2026, announcing a secondary public offering of 6,329,874 Class A common shares by OCM Njord Holdings S. r.l., an entity indirectly owned by funds managed by Oaktree Capital Management GP, LLC. The selling shareholder holds roughly 6% of Class A shares pre-offering. TORM is not selling shares and receives no proceeds. J.P. Morgan Securities LLC is sole underwriter, offering at a fixed price subject to change. The offering is subject to market conditions, so completion is uncertain. Watch pricing versus market and any residual Oaktree overhang.
